name: Utimutiraja’s widow
bio: She asks Kadir first to carry a plea for her family and later to act for the household. Her list of whom she blames is not a finding of guilt.
notes: fact: In Birch she seeks clemency, buries the dead, backs reprisals and leaves the city with Kadir; the account supplies no personal name (Birch III, pp. 149–152)
inference: Pires links the revolt to Utimutiraja’s money without identifying her part; she is not securely the woman in the Sequeira escape account (Pires II, p. 282; people-factions.md §2)
gameplay: Keep her dealings distinct from her husband’s bargains, and present her allegations as hers (people-factions.md §2)
